_comment: NAV-9 gate L1 + the watchable viewtest: ONE PX4 SITL camera-drone flying the full Challenge-2A landing pipeline [takeoff -> navigate -> land_on_pad] in the landing world. = the transport wiring of configs/sitl3_vision.json (mavsdk_sitl + gazebo frames via a gz->TCP bridge + ArUco) but with the LANDING phases + arena of configs/landing_real.json. ONE drone => ONE onboard camera renders comfortably under llvmpipe (RTF ~1.0, SIM-4), so this is the clean end-to-end proof AND the 2-camera footage run (sim/run_landing.sh viewtest adds the landing_view overview cam => 2 cams total). alpha targets pad_101 (gz 0,4) which sits directly behind the crate, so the visibility-graph planner MUST detour around the inflated keep-out => the obstacle-avoidance + visual-landing money shot. arena_name sitl_landing mirrors sim/worlds/landing_px4.sdf (north=gz+Y, east=gz+X). valid_marker_ids [101] = the ArUco the gz pad_101 renders. Budgets are WALL seconds (time.monotonic) sized generously for 1 transit + 1 landing at RTF~1.0; the orchestrator exits on all-DONE so they are a MAX, not a target.
